data: 10 RVS-Ego videos x 12 seeded questions; selection sets + frequencies from run 20260925_2237_t1_rekv_sharded artifacts/t1_rekv_log.jsonl (120 queries)
quantization: symmetric uniform quant-dequant simulating b-bit storage; K per-(head,channel) scales over tokens; V per-(head,token) scales over channels; fp32 scale computation; applied to stored KV of ONE block across all 24 layers; retrieval index (block_k reps) held full precision; GPU-cached copy offloaded before mutation
